data: Test your knowledge of famous celebrities, from Hollywood icons to music legends and beyond.
Which actor won the Academy Award for Best Actor in 2022?
Will Smith won the Oscar for Best Actor at the 2022 Academy Awards for his role in 'King Richard'.
In which country was Taylor Swift born?
Taylor Swift was born in Reading, Pennsylvania, United States on December 13, 1989.
Which celebrity is married to Hailey Baldwin?
Justin Bieber married model Hailey Baldwin in September 2018. They have been together since 2015.
What is Oprah Winfrey's real first name?
Oprah Winfrey's birth name is Orpah Gail Winfrey, but she is known as Oprah to the world.
Which actor starred as Tony Stark in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark/Iron Man throughout the Marvel Cinematic Universe films.
How many Grammy Awards did Beyoncé win at the 2023 Grammy Awards?
Beyoncé won 7 Grammy Awards at the 2023 Grammy Awards, breaking records with her wins.
Which musician is known as the 'King of Pop'?
Michael Jackson earned the title 'King of Pop' for his revolutionary music and influence on popular culture.
What is the real name of the rapper Eminem?
Eminem's real name is Marshall Mathers. He adopted the stage name based on his initials (M&M).
Which actress won the Academy Award for Best Actress in 2021?
Frances McDormand won the Oscar for Best Actress at the 2021 Academy Awards for her role in 'Nomadland'.
How many children does Angelina Jolie have?
Angelina Jolie has 6 children, whom she shares with Brad Pitt and some whom she adopted internationally.
What is the stage name of Marshall Bruce Mathers III?
Marshall Bruce Mathers III goes by the stage name Eminem, one of the best-selling artists of all time.
Which actor directed and starred in 'Dune: Part One' (2021)?
Denis Villeneuve directed 'Dune: Part One', though Timothée Chalamet starred as the protagonist Paul Atreides.
In what year did Meghan Markle marry Prince Harry?
Meghan Markle married Prince Harry on May 19, 2018 at St. George's Chapel in Windsor Castle.
Which actor is known for playing Batman in the 2022 film 'The Batman'?
Robert Pattinson starred as Batman/Bruce Wayne in the 2022 film directed by Matt Reeves.
How many Academy Awards has Meryl Streep been nominated for?
Meryl Streep has received 21 Academy Award nominations, more than any other actor in history, and has won 3 Oscars.
